sentence: This project studies precursor diagnoses and racial differences in light chain amyloidosis, and uses Bayesian machine learning to find patients who may be undiagnosed.
This project studies how the kidney changes during lactation to better understand how the body regulates magnesium and other essential minerals.
This project studies how bacteria inside tumors affect immune response and treatment in head and neck cancer using murine models.
This project builds a nanophotonic device that wirelessly performs electrophysiological studies of cardiac models in vitro.
This project builds computational radiomic tools that use CT scans to find which lung cancer patients may benefit from immunotherapy and to monitor tumor changes.
This project tries to identify animal reservoirs and transmission pathways that lead to human infections caused by uropathogenic Escherichia coli.
This project engineers proteins that can be imaged with ultrasound and uses them to image tumors and tumor-infiltrating immune cells.
This project studies how alternative polyadenylation helps prostate cancer progress to castration-resistance.
This project provides clean room manufacturing of cell and gene therapy products and other biologics for cancer clinical trials.
This project builds a micro-CT system that uses low-dose x-ray phase-contrast imaging to image soft tissue in animal models of cancer.
This project uses electronic health records and machine learning to improve how pregnant women are identified and how trial eligibility criteria are designed.
This project studies how the ototoxin gentamicin affects cells and function in the inner ear vestibular epithelia.
This project develops methods to make gene-edited cell products and runs specialized assays on product and patient samples from clinical trials.
This project tests genetically engineered human models of gliomas against patient-derived models using biological, molecular and drug therapy profiling.
This project studies genomic and metabolomic markers in newborn screening to improve interpretation of abnormal results and support more accurate second-tier testing.
This project compares lung function after radiotherapy in patients who get airway-sparing radiotherapy with patients who get current standard-of-care radiotherapy.
This project tries to identify microRNAs that suppress tumors in angiosarcoma and tests a repurposed antibiotic that enhances microRNA biogenesis.
This project identifies predictors of risk and resilience in psychosis and bipolar spectrum disorders and builds machine learning models using electronic health records.
This project builds and pilots a tool to improve how depression is managed in primary care for older adults with multimorbidity.
This project studies how a variant in an X-linked gene leads to abnormal interneuron development and seizure susceptibility in a mouse model.
